items.question: Trong câu "Many string problems are really about prefixes: a search box suggesting "cart", "carton", "cartoon" as you type "car"; a spell checker; a router finding the longest matching prefix of an IP address.", từ "prefix" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Many string problems are really about prefixes: a search box suggesting "cart", "carton", "cartoon" as you type "car"; a spell checker; a router finding the longest matching prefix of an IP address.", what does "prefix" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a group of letters at the start
a group of letters at the end
a shortened form of a word
items.explanation: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (danh từ): tiền tố. "Longest matching prefix" = tiền tố khớp dài nhất; trái nghĩa là suffix (hậu tố).
items.explanationEn: prefix /ˈpriː.fɪks/ (noun): a group of letters at the start. "Longest matching prefix" is the longest start that matches; the opposite is suffix.

items.question: Trong câu "To find every word starting with "car", a set must scan all N words.", từ "scan" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "To find every word starting with "car", a set must scan all N words.", what does "scan" (verb) mean?
options: duyệt lần lượt từng phần tử
optionsEn: to copy a paper as an image
to go through items one by one
items.explanation: scan /skæn/ (động từ): duyệt lần lượt từng phần tử. "Scan all N words" = duyệt qua cả N từ, tức tốn O(N). Cụm hay gặp: full scan, linear scan.
items.explanationEn: scan /skæn/ (verb): to go through items one by one. "Scan all N words" means checking every word, costing O(N). Common: full scan, linear scan.

items.question: Trong câu "Words that share a prefix share the nodes for that prefix, so "all words starting with car" is simply "everything below the node reached by c → a → r".", từ "share" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Words that share a prefix share the nodes for that prefix, so "all words starting with car" is simply "everything below the node reached by c → a → r".", what does "share" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to have or use in common
items.explanation: share /ʃeər/ (động từ): dùng chung. "Share a prefix" = có chung tiền tố; các từ chung tiền tố dùng chung node.
items.explanationEn: share /ʃeər/ (verb): to have or use in common. "Share a prefix" means having the same beginning; such words use the same nodes.

items.question: Trong câu "The root represents the empty string and holds no character.", từ "represent" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The root represents the empty string and holds no character.", what does "represent" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (động từ): đại diện cho, biểu thị. "X represents Y" = X biểu thị Y; danh từ: representation (cách biểu diễn).
items.explanationEn: represent /ˌrep.rɪˈzent/ (verb): to stand for. "X represents Y" means X stands for Y; noun: representation.

items.question: Trong câu "Each edge is labelled with one character; each node represents the prefix spelled by the path from the root to it.", từ "label" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each edge is labelled with one character; each node represents the prefix spelled by the path from the root to it.", what does "label" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to put a stamp on mail
to attach a name or tag to
items.explanation: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (động từ): gắn nhãn. "Be labelled with" = được gắn nhãn bằng; mỗi cạnh mang một ký tự.
items.explanationEn: label /ˈleɪ.bəl/ (verb): to attach a name or tag to. "Be labelled with" means carrying a tag; each edge carries one character.

items.question: Trong câu "Each edge is labelled with one character; each node represents the prefix spelled by the path from the root to it.", từ "spell" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each edge is labelled with one character; each node represents the prefix spelled by the path from the root to it.", what does "spell" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to form a word letter by letter
items.explanation: spell /spel/ (động từ): ghép thành chữ (theo thứ tự). "The prefix spelled by the path" = tiền tố được ghép từ các ký tự dọc đường đi.
items.explanationEn: spell /spel/ (verb): to form a word letter by letter. "The prefix spelled by the path" is the string formed by the letters along the path.

items.question: Trong câu "isEnd is essential.", từ "essential" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "isEnd is essential.", what does "essential" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: essential /ɪˈsen.ʃəl/ (tính từ): thiết yếu, không thể thiếu. "Essential" mạnh hơn "important": thiếu nó thì không phân biệt được từ và tiền tố.
items.explanationEn: essential /ɪˈsen.ʃəl/ (adjective): absolutely necessary. "Essential" is stronger than "important": without it, words and prefixes cannot be told apart.

items.question: Trong câu "Without the flag you cannot tell them apart.", từ "tell apart" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Without the flag you cannot tell them apart.", what does "tell apart" (phrase) mean?
optionsEn: to move far from each other
items.explanation: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (cụm từ): phân biệt được. "Tell A and B apart" / "tell them apart" = phân biệt A với B.
items.explanationEn: tell apart /tel əˈpɑːt/ (phrase): to see the difference between. "Tell A and B apart" or "tell them apart" means recognising the difference.

items.question: Trong câu "The depth of a node equals the length of its prefix, not the number of words.", từ "depth" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The depth of a node equals the length of its prefix, not the number of words.", what does "depth" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: depth /depθ/ (danh từ): độ sâu (số bước từ gốc). "Depth of a node" = số cạnh từ gốc tới node; tính từ: deep, cụm: depth-first.
items.explanationEn: depth /depθ/ (noun): the distance from the root. "Depth of a node" is the number of edges from the root; adjective: deep, as in depth-first.

items.question: Trong câu "Lookup cost therefore depends on the length of the string, never on how many words are stored.", từ "therefore" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Lookup cost therefore depends on the length of the string, never on how many words are stored.", what does "therefore" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: therefore /ˈðeə.fɔːr/ (trạng từ): vì vậy, do đó. "Therefore" nối kết luận với lý do phía trước; thường đứng giữa câu hoặc đầu câu.
items.explanationEn: therefore /ˈðeə.fɔːr/ (adverb): as a result, so. "Therefore" links a conclusion to the reason before it; it can sit mid-sentence or at the start.

items.question: Trong câu "σ (sigma) is the alphabet size: 26 for lowercase letters, 2 for bits, 128 for ASCII.", từ "alphabet" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "σ (sigma) is the alphabet size: 26 for lowercase letters, 2 for bits, 128 for ASCII.", what does "alphabet" (noun) mean?
options: thứ tự chữ cái trong từ
tập ký tự có thể dùng
optionsEn: the letter order in a word
items.explanation: alphabet /ˈæl.fə.bet/ (danh từ): tập ký tự có thể dùng. "Alphabet size" trong thuật toán = số ký tự khác nhau có thể xuất hiện (σ).
items.explanationEn: alphabet /ˈæl.fə.bet/ (noun): the set of possible symbols. In algorithms, "alphabet size" is the number of distinct symbols that can appear (σ).

items.question: Trong câu "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", từ "arbitrary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", what does "arbitrary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (tính từ): bất kỳ, không giới hạn. "Arbitrary text" = văn bản bất kỳ (ký tự nào cũng được); nghĩa khác: quyết định tuỳ tiện.
items.explanationEn: arbitrary /ˈɑː.bɪ.trər.i/ (adjective): any, with no restriction. "Arbitrary text" means text with any characters; another sense is a decision made on whim.

items.question: Trong câu "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", từ "waste" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", what does "waste" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: waste /weɪst/ (động từ): lãng phí. "Waste memory/time" = lãng phí bộ nhớ/thời gian; danh từ: a waste of space.
items.explanationEn: waste /weɪst/ (verb): to use without benefit. "Waste memory/time" means using it for nothing; noun: a waste of space.

items.question: Trong câu "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", từ "enormous" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Array nodes are faster and simpler in interviews with "lowercase English letters"; Map nodes are the safe default for arbitrary text, where σ-slot arrays would waste enormous memory.", what does "enormous" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: enormous /ɪˈnɔː.məs/ (tính từ): cực kỳ lớn. "Enormous" mạnh hơn "large/big"; hay đi với memory, amount, cost.
items.explanationEn: enormous /ɪˈnɔː.məs/ (adjective): extremely large. "Enormous" is stronger than "large"; it often goes with memory, amount, cost.

items.question: Trong câu "Walk the word from the root.", từ "walk" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Walk the word from the root.", what does "walk" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to step through one by one
items.explanation: walk /wɔːk/ (động từ): đi lần lượt qua (từng bước). "Walk the word/the list" = duyệt lần lượt từng phần tử; danh từ: a tree walk.
items.explanationEn: walk /wɔːk/ (verb): to step through one by one. "Walk the word/the list" means stepping through each element; noun: a tree walk.

items.question: Trong câu "For each character, follow the existing child or create it.", từ "existing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "For each character, follow the existing child or create it.", what does "existing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: existing /ɪɡˈzɪs.tɪŋ/ (tính từ): đã có sẵn. "The existing child" = node con đã tồn tại; động từ: exist.
items.explanationEn: existing /ɪɡˈzɪs.tɪŋ/ (adjective): already present. "The existing child" is a child node that is already there; verb: exist.

items.question: Trong câu "Mark the last node as a word end.", từ "mark" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mark the last node as a word end.", what does "mark" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mark /mɑːk/ (động từ): đánh dấu. "Mark X as Y" = đánh dấu X là Y; ngược lại: unmark (bỏ đánh dấu).
items.explanationEn: mark /mɑːk/ (verb): to flag or label. "Mark X as Y" means flagging X as Y; the opposite is unmark.

items.question: Trong câu "That sharing is where tries save space on dictionaries full of common prefixes.", từ "save" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That sharing is where tries save space on dictionaries full of common prefixes.", what does "save" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: save /seɪv/ (động từ): tiết kiệm. "Save space/time" = tiết kiệm bộ nhớ/thời gian; khác với "save a file" (lưu tệp).
items.explanationEn: save /seɪv/ (verb): to use less of. "Save space/time" means using less; different from "save a file".

items.question: Trong câu "That sharing is where tries save space on dictionaries full of common prefixes.", từ "common" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "That sharing is where tries save space on dictionaries full of common prefixes.", what does "common" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: common /ˈkɒm.ən/ (tính từ): chung (nhiều từ cùng có). "Common prefix" = tiền tố chung; cụm liên quan: longest common prefix.
items.explanationEn: common /ˈkɒm.ən/ (adjective): shared by several items. "Common prefix" means a prefix shared by several words; related: longest common prefix.

items.question: Trong câu "Space: O(L) new nodes in the worst case (no shared prefix), O(1) if the word's path already exists.", từ "worst case" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space: O(L) new nodes in the worst case (no shared prefix), O(1) if the word's path already exists.", what does "worst case" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (cụm từ): trường hợp xấu nhất. "In the worst case" = trong trường hợp xấu nhất; đối lập: best case, average case.
items.explanationEn: worst case /ˌwɜːst ˈkeɪs/ (phrase): the least favourable situation. "In the worst case" means under the least favourable input; contrast: best case, average case.

items.question: Trong câu "Inserting the same word twice just sets isEnd = true again — the trie behaves like a set.", từ "behave" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Inserting the same word twice just sets isEnd = true again — the trie behaves like a set.", what does "behave" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to act or work in a way
items.explanation: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (động từ): hoạt động, hành xử. "Behave like X" = hoạt động giống X; danh từ: behaviour/behavior.
items.explanationEn: behave /bɪˈheɪv/ (verb): to act or work in a way. "Behave like X" means working the same way as X; noun: behaviour/behavior.

items.question: Trong câu "Both walk the same path; they differ only in the final check.", từ "differ" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Both walk the same path; they differ only in the final check.", what does "differ" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (động từ): khác nhau. "Differ in X" = khác nhau ở X; tính từ: different.
items.explanationEn: differ /ˈdɪf.ər/ (verb): to be unlike. "Differ in X" means being unlike in X; adjective: different.

items.question: Trong câu "Factor the walk into a helper:", từ "factor" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Factor the walk into a helper:", what does "factor" (verb) mean?
options: tính đến như một yếu tố
optionsEn: to pull out into a separate part
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (động từ): tách ra (thành hàm riêng). "Factor X into/out into a helper" = tách X ra hàm phụ; liên quan: refactor.
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (verb): to pull out into a separate part. "Factor X into a helper" means moving it into its own function; related: refactor.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic bug is writing search as findNode(word) !== null — that is startsWith, and it wrongly reports "ca" as a word.", từ "classic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic bug is writing search as findNode(word) !== null — that is startsWith, and it wrongly reports "ca" as a word.", what does "classic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (tính từ): điển hình, kinh điển. "A classic bug/problem" = lỗi/bài điển hình ai cũng hay gặp.
items.explanationEn: classic /ˈklæs.ɪk/ (adjective): typical and well known. "A classic bug/problem" is a typical one that many people run into.

items.question: Trong câu "The classic bug is writing search as findNode(word) !== null — that is startsWith, and it wrongly reports "ca" as a word.", từ "wrongly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The classic bug is writing search as findNode(word) !== null — that is startsWith, and it wrongly reports "ca" as a word.", what does "wrongly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: wrongly /ˈrɒŋ.li/ (trạng từ): một cách sai. "Wrongly reports X as Y" = báo sai X là Y; đồng nghĩa: incorrectly.
items.explanationEn: wrongly /ˈrɒŋ.li/ (adverb): incorrectly. "Wrongly reports X as Y" means reporting it incorrectly; synonym: incorrectly.

items.question: Trong câu "Time: O(L) for both; they can stop early at the first missing character.", từ "missing" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Time: O(L) for both; they can stop early at the first missing character.", what does "missing" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: missing /ˈmɪs.ɪŋ/ (tính từ): bị thiếu, không có. "The first missing character" = ký tự đầu tiên không có trong trie.
items.explanationEn: missing /ˈmɪs.ɪŋ/ (adjective): absent, not there. "The first missing character" is the first one with no matching child.

items.question: Trong câu "Space: O(1) — just a pointer.", từ "pointer" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Space: O(1) — just a pointer.", what does "pointer" (noun) mean?
options: biến trỏ tới một đối tượng
items.explanation: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (danh từ): biến trỏ tới một đối tượng. "Just a pointer" = chỉ một biến tham chiếu tới node hiện tại, nên O(1) bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: pointer /ˈpɔɪn.tər/ (noun): a reference to an object. "Just a pointer" means only one reference to the current node, so O(1) space.

items.question: Trong câu "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", từ "traversal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", what does "traversal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (danh từ): sự duyệt qua (cấu trúc). "Depth-first traversal" = duyệt theo chiều sâu; động từ: traverse.
items.explanationEn: traversal /trəˈvɜː.səl/ (noun): visiting every node in order. "Depth-first traversal" visits nodes going deep first; verb: traverse.

items.question: Trong câu "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", từ "record" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", what does "record" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (động từ): ghi lại, lưu lại. "Record every node" = ghi lại mọi node thoả điều kiện vào kết quả.
items.explanationEn: record /rɪˈkɔːd/ (verb): to write down, keep. "Record every node" means adding each matching node to the results.

items.question: Trong câu "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", từ "as you go" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Autocomplete = findNode(prefix), then a depth-first traversal of that subtree, building the string as you go and recording every node where isEnd is true.", what does "as you go" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: as you go /æz juː ɡəʊ/ (cụm từ): dần dần trong lúc làm. "Build X as you go" = xây dựng X dần dần trong quá trình duyệt.
items.explanationEn: as you go /æz juː ɡəʊ/ (phrase): step by step while working. "Build X as you go" means building it gradually during the process.

items.question: Trong câu "Because DFS visits a parent before its children and children in sorted order, results come out in lexicographic order, with shorter words before their extensions.", từ "lexicographic" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because DFS visits a parent before its children and children in sorted order, results come out in lexicographic order, with shorter words before their extensions.", what does "lexicographic" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: lexicographic /ˌlek.sɪ.kəˈɡræf.ɪk/ (tính từ): theo thứ tự từ điển. "Lexicographic order" = thứ tự từ điển, so sánh từng ký tự từ trái sang phải.
items.explanationEn: lexicographic /ˌlek.sɪ.kəˈɡræf.ɪk/ (adjective): in dictionary order. "Lexicographic order" compares strings character by character, like a dictionary.

items.question: Trong câu "Because DFS visits a parent before its children and children in sorted order, results come out in lexicographic order, with shorter words before their extensions.", từ "extension" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Because DFS visits a parent before its children and children in sorted order, results come out in lexicographic order, with shorter words before their extensions.", what does "extension" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: extension /ɪkˈsten.ʃən/ (danh từ): bản kéo dài (thêm ký tự). "Shorter words before their extensions" = "car" đứng trước "cart", "care".
items.explanationEn: extension /ɪkˈsten.ʃən/ (noun): a longer form of it. "Shorter words before their extensions" means "car" comes before "cart" and "care".

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting keys adds a factor for σ, which is a constant for a fixed alphabet.", từ "factor" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting keys adds a factor for σ, which is a constant for a fixed alphabet.", what does "factor" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (danh từ): hệ số nhân (độ phức tạp). "Adds a factor for σ" = độ phức tạp nhân thêm một hệ số phụ thuộc σ.
items.explanationEn: factor /ˈfæk.tər/ (noun): a multiplier in a cost. "Adds a factor for σ" means the cost gets multiplied by a term depending on σ.

items.question: Trong câu "Sorting keys adds a factor for σ, which is a constant for a fixed alphabet.", từ "constant" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Sorting keys adds a factor for σ, which is a constant for a fixed alphabet.", what does "constant" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (danh từ): hằng số. "Is a constant" = không đổi theo kích thước input, nên thường bỏ khỏi Big-O.
items.explanationEn: constant /ˈkɒn.stənt/ (noun): a fixed value. "Is a constant" means it does not grow with input size, so Big-O usually drops it.

items.question: Trong câu "Stop as soon as the current path is not a prefix — one trie walk replaces a separate grid search per word.", từ "separate" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Stop as soon as the current path is not a prefix — one trie walk replaces a separate grid search per word.", what does "separate" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (tính từ): riêng rẽ, tách biệt. "A separate search per word" = mỗi từ một lần tìm riêng; động từ separate đọc /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsep.ər.ət/ (adjective): individual, apart. "A separate search per word" means one individual search for each word; the verb is /ˈsep.ər.eɪt/.

items.question: Trong câu "Remove found words (or clear isEnd) to avoid duplicates.", từ "avoid" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Remove found words (or clear isEnd) to avoid duplicates.", what does "avoid" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (động từ): tránh. "Avoid duplicates" = tránh kết quả trùng lặp; theo sau là danh từ hoặc V-ing.
items.explanationEn: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (verb): to prevent. "Avoid duplicates" means preventing repeated results; it takes a noun or -ing form.

items.question: Trong câu "insert, search, startsWith and delete are all O(L) in the string length, independent of N.", từ "independent of" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "insert, search, startsWith and delete are all O(L) in the string length, independent of N.", what does "independent of" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: independent of /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt əv/ (cụm từ): không phụ thuộc vào. "Independent of N" = không phụ thuộc số từ N; đối lập: depends on.
items.explanationEn: independent of /ˌɪn.dɪˈpen.dənt əv/ (phrase): not affected by. "Independent of N" means the cost does not change with N; opposite: depends on.

items.question: Trong câu "Trade-off: high memory — O(S) nodes, up to O(S · σ) slots with array children.", từ "trade-off" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Trade-off: high memory — O(S) nodes, up to O(S · σ) slots with array children.", what does "trade-off" (noun) mean?
optionsEn: a balance of gains and costs
items.explanation: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (danh từ): sự đánh đổi. "Trade-off" = được cái này thì mất cái kia; ở đây: nhanh với tiền tố nhưng tốn bộ nhớ.
items.explanationEn: trade-off /ˈtreɪd.ɒf/ (noun): a balance of gains and costs. "Trade-off" means gaining one thing costs another; here, fast prefixes but high memory.

items.question: Trong câu "Mention radix trees as the fix.", từ "mention" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Mention radix trees as the fix.", what does "mention" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (động từ): nhắc đến. "Mention X as the fix" = nêu X là cách khắc phục; danh từ: a mention.
items.explanationEn: mention /ˈmen.ʃən/ (verb): to refer to briefly. "Mention X as the fix" means naming X as the solution; noun: a mention.

items.question: Trong câu "Reach for a trie in: autocomplete, spell check, wildcard dictionary, Word Search II, longest-prefix matching, max XOR (binary trie).", từ "reach for" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Reach for a trie in: autocomplete, spell check, wildcard dictionary, Word Search II, longest-prefix matching, max XOR (binary trie).", what does "reach for" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: reach for /riːtʃ fɔːr/ (cụm từ): chọn dùng (công cụ). "Reach for X" (nghĩa bóng) = nghĩ ngay tới và chọn dùng X khi gặp bài phù hợp.
items.explanationEn: reach for /riːtʃ fɔːr/ (phrase): to choose as a tool. "Reach for X" figuratively means picking X as your go-to tool for the job.

items.question: Trong câu "isEnd separates real words from mere prefixes such as "ca".", từ "mere" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "isEnd separates real words from mere prefixes such as "ca".", what does "mere" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: mere /mɪər/ (tính từ): chỉ là, đơn thuần. "Mere prefixes" = chỉ đơn thuần là tiền tố, không phải từ; trạng từ: merely.
items.explanationEn: mere /mɪər/ (adjective): only, nothing more than. "Mere prefixes" are only prefixes and nothing more; adverb: merely.

items.question: Trong câu "A trie (prefix tree) indexes strings character by character; node depth equals prefix length.", từ "index" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A trie (prefix tree) indexes strings character by character; node depth equals prefix length.", what does "index" (verb) mean?
options: sắp xếp để tra cứu nhanh
items.explanation: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (động từ): sắp xếp để tra cứu nhanh. "Index strings" = tổ chức chuỗi để tra cứu nhanh; danh từ: an index.
items.explanationEn: index /ˈɪn.deks/ (verb): to organise for fast lookup. "Index strings" means organising them for fast lookup; noun: an index.
